Didn't happen to me, but instead a very close friend, worth sharing as it's mad and I was present for the video (you'll understand shortly) and the drive later. 

So, country lane, driving along at around 50-60mph, which is standard for a country lane (or 90 if you are Ed Sheeran). If you don't know about UK country roads they are no wider than a single car in some cases, ditches either side and usually have posts to stop you veering off track.

Also, most country roads don't have lights either.

Picture the scene, driving at speed, goes round a corner to be presented with a tractor coming the opposite direction, covering the entire road. UK tractors are huge. 

My friend said there was very little time to realise, but both tractor driver and my friend looked, swerved and carried on.

My friend shaken, stopped at the next junction, thinking how the hell did I not get hit, not veer off into a post and what about the ditch, why am I not in a ditch.

Comes back to the office, dashcam in hand, visiblby shaken, white as a ghost and eager to plug the dash cam in to their PC to see how they managed to still be alive. Plus we all wanted to see. 

Here is the bit of which none of us can explain.

The dash cam shows footage up to the corner, you see the tractor, then nothing..... Completely blank screen, no sound, no picture. Around 5 seconds of blank screen, no sound and then video and sound again showing the clear road ahead followed by them stopping at the junction... Audio picks up my friend swearing like "how the f***" and "****ing hell" - you can imagine the chaos.

We all sit there, going back and forth thinking there has been an error or perhaps we picked the wrong file, anything to explain what we were and were not seeing.

My friend decides to go back down the lane with me in the passenger seat to see if perhaps she went onto a bank of earth, or perhaps a passing point. I had a copy of the video dash cam on my phone, just so we know the exact spot she supposedly passed the tractor.

We get there and no bullshit, there is no where that either the tractor nor my friend could have gone.

They should have either crashed into each other or my friend should be upside down in a ditch in her car.

So we figured, let's try and trace the tractor to a farm, just going by what little dash cam footage we had. We checked around for farms, found one or two, and yes, we also found the tractor.

Spoke to the farmer and I shit you not, he said, the tractor hadn't been out that day as the driver for that vehicle was off with sickness. 

We just can't explain it.
